arguments.name: Constrained four-group palette allocation with matched privileged control
arguments.description: RGB-only palette-mode assignment oracle on frozen C110–174s trajectory. Four static fixture groups vs equally informed global-color oracle, two-group/permutation/donor controls, identical reference information/allowed palette/cues/history/fades. No audio-learning or user-preference claim.
